scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter './plugins/*' --if-present test && pnpm run test:compat
scripts.test:compat: cd .paperclip/packages/plugins/sdk && pnpm exec vitest run tests/artifacts.test.ts --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @paperclipai/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @paperclipai/plugin-sdk build && pnpm --filter './plugins/*' --if-present typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
